think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s purpose and normal operating range/type in PostgreSQL. 2) Check whether it has documented sentinel values (e.g., -1, 0) that switch the parameter into a qualitatively different mode (disable/auto/infinite) rather than just being a smaller/larger numeric setting. 3) If such sentinel values exist and change behavior categorically, classify as a special knob and record the sentinel value(s); otherwise classify as not special.
